title: Coordinator-precommitted direct covariance and multi-epoch escape route
statement: This coordinator-proposed route suggests seeking a finite-time expected-distance proof directly from the full RPCD second-moment operator, a justified reachable cone, or multi-epoch powers, without assuming the stronger inverse-moment claim C051. It is not evidence of an independent sealed rollout.

signature.representation: The full covariance map M_A(X)=E[T_pi X T_pi^T], its powers, or an explicitly characterized reachable invariant cone
signature.state_or_invariant: A second-moment norm, cone gauge, or block-power contraction that controls every rank-one initial covariance
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The structured RPCD covariance dynamics have a universal mu-scale finite-time gap after a constant-size or explicitly controlled multi-epoch block.
information_retained: full second-moment operator or a proved reachable cone
information_discarded: fixed-A one-epoch energy as the terminal certificate
prefix inverse moments as an assumed sufficient route
Bellman, cycle-cut, and boundary-shorting derivation history before the route card
signature.target_implication: A uniform block-power or cone contraction gives C050 directly and need not establish C051.
signature.known_failure_mode: A full-space spectral-radius claim may ignore non-normal prefactors or fail to imply a uniform finite-time bound on every reachable rank-one covariance.
signature.verifier_class: independent covariance construction, exact small-n powers, and adversarial non-normal transfer checks
